metadata.title: Uniruledness and the sign of total scalar curvature
metadata.abstract: For every integer $n\ge3$, we construct a smooth projective manifold $X$ of complex dimension $n$ whose canonical bundle is not pseudoeffective, or equivalently, which is uniruled, but every Kähler metric has negative total scalar curvature. In particular, $X$ admits no Kähler metric of positive scalar curvature, while it admits a Riemannian metric of positive scalar curvature. Thus the equivalence between uniruledness and the existence of a Kähler metric with positive scalar curvature holds in complex dimensions one and two, but fails in higher dimensions.

analysis.progressType: 单有理性与总标量曲率反例
analysis.workSummary: 对每个复维数 n≥3，构造光滑射影直纹簇，其每个 Kähler 类 α 都满足 K_X·α^(n−1)>0，因此所有 Kähler 度量总标量曲率为负；同一底层光滑流形仍有正标量曲率 Riemannian 度量。
analysis.breakthrough: 表明低维的单有理性与存在正标量曲率 Kähler 度量的等价在高维失效。
analysis.limitations: 结论区分 Kähler 与一般 Riemannian 度量；反例从复维数三开始，不能套用于曲线和曲面。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露附录 A 的显式例子由 Rethlas 代理通过 ChatGPT-5.6-sol 构造，数学陈述由作者撰写。
